audit_scope.description: This batch covers EL-only specs: gas repricing (EIP-1884), difficulty adjustment (EIP-100), blob transaction distribution (EIP-8094), modular exponentiation precompile (EIP-198), and paginated receipt protocol (EIP-7975).

misclassified_entities.reason: From EIP-1884: 'External Caller' is too generic. A contract or EOA calling another contract is internal EVM execution context, not an external entity crossing a trust boundary. The real external entity is the transaction submitter.

From EIP-198: 'Calling Contract' invoking MODEXP precompile is internal EVM execution. The precompile is called via CALL opcode within EVM. The external entity is whoever submitted the transaction containing this call.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter via JSON-RPC
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Covers EIP-1884 (transactions invoking repriced opcodes), EIP-198 (transactions calling MODEXP precompile). Any user or contract deployer can submit transactions via unauthenticated JSON-RPC. All transaction content is untrusted and must be fully validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Proposer via P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: From EIP-100: block proposer provides timestamp and uncle references used in difficulty calculation. Proposer is a network peer with no authenticated channel. Timestamps and uncle claims must be independently validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer via devp2p (Blob Distribution)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: From EIP-8094: peers announce and serve blob transactions over unauthenticated P2P. Blob data and vhash correspondence must be validated before forwarding. Peers may provide incomplete or malicious blob data.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer via eth/70 (Receipt Protocol)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: From EIP-7975: peers serve paginated receipt data over unauthenticated P2P. Receipt data must be validated against known block headers (count, size bounds). Malicious peers may send oversized or fabricated receipts.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Miner via P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P block propagation with manipulated uncle references
trusted_external_entities.rationale: From EIP-100: attacker attempting to game uncle rate for issuance manipulation. All miner-produced blocks are received over unauthenticated P2P and must have difficulty recalculated independently.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: eth_sendRawTransaction RPC → Transaction Pool → EVM Execution
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full transaction validation required: signature verification, nonce check, gas limit check, balance sufficiency. For EIP-1884: gas costs must reflect updated schedule. For EIP-198: MODEXP gas pricing must accurately reflect computation cost to prevent DoS.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P block import → Header Validation → Difficulty Calculation
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block timestamp must be validated against parent timestamp bounds. Uncle references must be cryptographically verified against unclesHash. Difficulty must be independently recomputed using EIP-100 formula; proposer-supplied difficulty value is never trusted.

All received blob data must have hash correspondence validated against transaction vhashes. Nodes MUST NOT forward transactions until all blobs are received and validated. Incomplete blob responses must be handled gracefully without memory exhaustion.

Receipt data must be validated: count matches transaction count per block, individual receipt size bounded by gas_limit/8, total size bounded by block gas limit. Pagination state must be tracked to prevent infinite request loops. Buffer sizes must be bounded to prevent memory exhaustion.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P block propagation → Uncle Validation → Difficulty Adjustment
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Uncle blocks must be validated for inclusion eligibility (within 6 ancestor generations). Difficulty adjustment formula (EIP-100) must account for uncle rate to prevent issuance gaming. Timestamp manipulation for difficulty reduction must be bounded.
